segments.title: Zoom shows its level
segments.body: Press ⌘+ twice, then ⌘− twice. Each press now opens a small panel under the magnifier with the new level, which closes on its own 1.5 s after the last one. 0.2.43-nightly.3 zoomed the page and showed nothing.

segments.title: Fold the pinned tabs
segments.body: Point at the line between the pinned tabs and the rest and “Pinned” appears at its left end. Click it and the pinned rows fold away, leaving “› Pinned” on the line. On 0.2.43-nightly.3 the line showed only Clear, and the same click did nothing.

segments.title: Bookmark folders with favicons
segments.body: Click a folder on the bookmarks bar: the menu is now Ardia's own, with each site's icon, and a click elsewhere closes it. Then the bar's new Large size. 0.2.43-nightly.3 opened a native menu with a globe on every row, and had no Large size.
segments.note: Before menu drawn from the items nightly.3 logged

segments.title: Mute one tab, not the site
segments.body: Two tabs on the same site are playing. Click the speaker on the first: only that tab goes quiet, and the second keeps playing. On 0.2.43-nightly.3 the same click muted both.

segments.title: Links from pinned tabs peek
segments.body: In a pinned tab, a plain click on a link to another site opens it in a Peek, and the pinned tab stays on its page (Settings › Tabs › Links, on here). On 0.2.43-nightly.3 the pinned tab went to the other site.

segments.title: Memory Saver settings
segments.body: Settings › Advanced › Performance now has Chrome's Memory Saver: on by default, a choice of how much memory to save, and a list of sites to always keep active. 0.2.43-nightly.3 had no setting for it, only Battery Saver.

segments.title: Smaller profile icons
segments.body: With profile icons on, the switcher at the bottom of the sidebar draws them at 11 pt in an 18 pt cell. 0.2.43-nightly.3 drew them at 13 pt in a 22 pt cell.
